blockingFindings.summary: OpenClaw beta5 scans installed dependency runtime code and blocks PLUR1BUS when direct LanceDB/OpenAI dependencies are installed.
blockingFindings.details: Normal tarball install failed on child_process/dynamic-code findings in openai helpers, apache-arrow, @types/node, and @lancedb/lancedb.
blockingFindings.impact: Packaged PLUR1BUS v3 cannot be considered a clean normal third-party plugin install on beta5 without an OpenClaw trust/allowlist strategy or a different dependency architecture.
blockingFindings.mitigation: Forced install proves runtime load/doctor can pass, but force is not a release-quality normal path. Best next step is an OpenClaw-side trusted native dependency policy for known heavy native packages or a PLUR1BUS split package with operator-approved dependency lane.
